scope.why_previous_204: 201 HTML + 2 inline JS partials + templates/__init__.py; excludes generated __pycache__.

inline_template_review.templates/assignment_detail_student.html: Answer/attachment Markdown, feedback/result/status and submission busy rendering; UI modal consumers inherit shared owner.
inline_template_review.templates/assignment_detail_teacher.html: Grading/list/loading/busy data; native details retained. Status dropdown confirmed real owner and delegated to menu_controls for shared adapter.
inline_template_review.templates/assignment_wrong_summary.html: Tabs and two modal owners delegated to menu_controls; output data stays immediate.
inline_template_review.templates/base.html: Back-to-top threshold visibility; shared base UI/modal/popup/AI consumers inherited.
inline_template_review.templates/exam_editor.html: Four explicit modal roots: scoring, JSON import, AI generation, paper preview migrated to domain adapter; fields/data updates remain immediate.
inline_template_review.templates/exam_take.html: Answer and timer state, question navigation and submit state; data updates remain immediate.
inline_template_review.templates/report_card.html: Unavailable chart fallback visibility; document navigation inherits shared cross-document policy.
inline_template_review.templates/submission_detail.html: Answer/feedback/Markdown/TOC rendering; UI modal consumers inherit shared owner.
inline_template_review.templates/wrong_book.html: Chart/data absence visibility; document navigation inherits shared cross-document policy.
inline_template_review.templates/manage/academic_overview.html: Query/action progress/status result rendering; source state changes do not imply destructive popup lifecycle.
inline_template_review.templates/manage/layout.html: Removed 150ms JS route delay; native same-origin view transitions. Explicit sidebar domain items use shared inline panel presence.
inline_template_review.templates/manage/student_detail.html: Successful model deletion removes its row/section; no retained popup exit is inferred from that deletion.
inline_template_review.templates/partials/app_bottomnav.html: Current-route class/aria startup state and native navigation links.
inline_template_review.templates/partials/exams/scripts.html: Preview, reverse material, assignment modals use shared domain adapter; reverse action menu uses bindMenu/nativeActions; tag filter/editor use createPopoverSystem. Filters/data/list replacement remains data rendering.
inline_template_review.templates/manage/system/diagnostics.html: Load/status/result output; no independent popup lifecycle identified.
Existing window.UI.openModal owns detail dialog; status/spinner data remains immediate.
inline_template_review.templates/manage/system/users.html: Three domain dialogs: edit, membership, password; table filtering and submit busy preserved.
